sentences.text: The learned counsel for the Applicant states that Section 328 of the IPC is only non-bailable Section and all other Sections are bailable.

4. It is submitted that the issue of the applicability of section 328 of Indian Penal Code in such cases is pending before the Supreme Court in a batch of petitions, in which interim protection has been granted by the Supreme Court.
5.
The learned Additional Public Prosecutor seeks time.

ORDER (i) In the event of his arrest in connection with investigation of Crime No.15 of 2022 registered with Vairag Police Station, the applicant shall be released on bail on executing a P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer on 28 February 2022 and 1 March 2022 between 11.00 am to 1.00 p.m. and as and when called by the investigating officer and shall co-operate with the Investigating Agency.
 N.S. Kamble page 2 of 3  19-aba-461-2022 (iii) In the event of breach of any of the conditions the interim protection is liable to be vacated.
(iv) This order shall remain enforce till the next date.
(v) Stand over to 14 March 2022.
C.V. BHADANG, J.
